description: This PHP file is a stand-alone script used for upgrading SuiteCRM instances via command line. It contains utility functions, usage instructions, and main execution logic for handling upgrade packages, configuration, and file operations specific to SuiteCRM and DCE instances.

methods.name: prepSystemForUpgradeSilent
methods.description: Prepares the system for upgrade by ensuring necessary directories exist.

methods.name: clearCacheSU
methods.description: Recursively deletes cache files with specific extensions.

methods.name: checkConfigForPermissions
methods.description: Ensures default permissions are set in config.php.

methods.name: checkLoggerSettings
methods.description: Ensures logger settings are configured in config.php.

methods.name: checkResourceSettings
methods.description: Ensures resource management settings are configured in config.php.

methods.name: merge_passwordsetting
methods.description: Merges default password settings into the configuration.

methods.name: addDefaultModuleRoles
methods.description: Adds default ACL roles for modules.

methods.name: verifyArguments
methods.description: Verifies command-line arguments and environment to determine upgrade type.

methods.name: upgradeDCEFiles
methods.description: Copies and updates upgrade files for DCE instances.
